title: Dekh kar hairaan
body:
dekh kar hairaan khuda hai asghar e baysheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
<<DIVIDER>>
chad ke naize pe bachaya tu ne asghar la ilaah
deen e ahmed pe hua yun teer kha kar tu fida
marhaba kehna pada khud kaatib e taqdeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid ki tanhaiyan aur is pe zaalim ke sitam
bhool jayegi layeen ko aur kaano ke zakhm
qabr bhoolegi na teri haye kabhi humsheer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
saath jab baba ke asghar ko na payegi rubab
leke khaali godh kaise shaam jayegi rubab
bas khayal aata hai maqtal mein yehi shabbir ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
jhoolta naize pe jhoola na ye bhoolega jahan
ta abad royenge us ko ye zameen o aasman
kar gaya nakaam zaalim ki jo har tadbeer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar asghar ka hasna ro rahe thay ashqiyan
dekh asghar ki shuja'at jhoomte thay ambiya
saare mil kar dekhte thay deen ki tanveer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
<<DIVIDER>>
aa rahi khursheed hai ab bhi sada e karbala
na chupega us ka khoon hai jo bina e la ilaah
laakh dunya ye chupaye khoone be-taqseer ko
kar diya do lakht jis ne hurmala ke teer ko
dekh kar hairaan...
author: Haider Khursheed
